# Herpesviruses

> *Enveloped DNA viruses that persist for life in a latent state after the first infection and can reactivate when immunity falls.*

::: {.callout-note}
## In preparation
The plan for this chapter:
:::

| Part of the chapter | Plan |
|---|---|
| Learning objectives | Describe the group by its traits; explain one mechanism of harm for each main virus; recognise the enabling conditions that point to each |
| The group in one sentence | Enveloped DNA viruses that persist for life in a latent state after the first infection and can reactivate when immunity falls. |
| Main viruses | Herpes simplex virus; varicella-zoster virus; cytomegalovirus |
| Supporting viruses | Epstein–Barr virus |
| Later in the course | Dermatology, neurology and transplant medicine |
| Scenario questions | Most likely virus, with options restricted to the group; feedback names the discriminating clue |
